targets.outcome_quote: While the timing of ﬁrst-time NOT alerts was not replicated, there appears to be common pattern of the total frequency of NOT alerts among clients in group therapy and individual therapy.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicitly replicated increased NOT rate but not timing. The low-power caveat about timing does not erase the positive rate replication or the explicit contrast. Shimokawa et al. supplies the archival comparison data used by the target, not a separate targeted finding.
